value.rationale: Exact reproducibility of whole cluster blocks versus pairwise shared membership is a substantive mathematical distinction. In the critical theta~sqrt(n) regime the former has an entire spatial Poisson limit with vanishing nontrivial full blocks, while the latter has linearly growing expected shared pairs. This gives a natural two-sample clustering stability law, not an arbitrary numerical slice; no downstream theorem is required.
